GO-2026-6651 github.com/xtls/xray-core v1.260327.0 2026-11-30 patches/xray-pinned-ca-servername.patch the shipped Xray binary is v26.3.27 built with patches/xray-pinned-ca-servername.patch, which refuses a pinned CA certificate when the client has no server name; the node process uses xray-core only for protos and config structs; bumping go.mod to the fixed pseudo-version v1.260327.1-0.20260710210335-64fada32b5b9 changes the app/router proto (Domain to geodata.DomainRule, GeoIP to IPRule) and silently corrupts AddRoutingRule against the v26.3.27 binary; remove this waiver when the shipped binary moves to an xray-core release with the fix
